purpose: Provenance and adoption map for external AI/documentation resources used to improve app-java-v3 defect knowledge. This registry does not authorize live Saleor access or override the repository's pinned contract.

resources.name: llms.txt
resources.purpose: Page index, agent resources and published Saleor schema index

resources.name: Documentation MCP
resources.purpose: Read-only search_docs/get_page/list_pages/get_navigation; no live store or GraphQL execution

resources.name: Saleor MCP Overview
resources.purpose: Live Saleor Cloud versus self-hosted read-only MCP; identity, permission-aware access, audited operations and limitations.

resources.name: Saleor MCP Authentication
resources.purpose: User OAuth versus autonomous-agent access keys, scopes, permission levels, revocation and token handling.

resources.name: Saleor MCP Tools
resources.purpose: Authoritative tool contract, arguments, response shape, mutation summaries and pre-execution document checks.

limitations: Documentation MCP is read-only and does not connect to a Saleor instance.
Saleor Cloud MCP and self-hosted Saleor MCP are separate live-data capabilities; neither is used by app-java-v3.
Schema-only GraphQL MCP must consume this repository's pinned SDL if used; never upstream main.

documentationMcp.purpose: Search and read official documentation only; does not connect to a store or execute GraphQL.

semantics.connection_info: Call first to establish the connected store and current access/upgrade state.
semantics.introspect_schema: Inspect the permitted live-store schema before querying or changing data.
semantics.run_query: Read live data within granted permissions.
semantics.run_high_impact_mutation: Use the separately governed high-impact operation path.

schemaOnlyGraphQlMcp.purpose: Offline schema/contract inspection; not a live-store data connection.
schemaOnlyGraphQlMcp.schemaSource: This repository's pinned Saleor 3.23.43 SDL at saleor/graphql/schema.graphql.

protocolDiscovery.rule: Do not assume tools or arguments from a stale copy; inspect the connected server's advertised tool metadata.

identityAndAccess.userOAuth: A staff-facing assistant acts as the signed-in staff user.
identityAndAccess.accessKey: An unattended agent/automation acts as the app, limited by the key's area-level permissions.
identityAndAccess.scopeRule: Requested OAuth scopes can narrow current access; they cannot widen access the user/app/group policy does not grant.
identityAndAccess.elevation: Call connection_info first; request upgradePermissions only after the user explicitly agrees.
identityAndAccess.revocation: Connections can be revoked; access-key changes and revocation take effect on the next request.
identityAndAccess.credentialBoundary: MCP clients never receive Saleor tokens.

operationSafety.toolVisibility: Mutation tools are exposed only when the connection has access to execute them.
operationSafety.response: { data, errors }; inspect the mutation's own errors before treating the action as successful.
operationSafety.activityLog: Every tool call is visible in the app Activity tab; mutation summaries are retained for 90 days.
operationSafety.summaryGuidance: Use object IDs and changed values; keep the explanation factual and minimal.

documentChecks.note: Saleor-specific MCP validation limits; do not adopt as app-java-v3 platform limits.

principles: timeout or ambiguous result is unknown
distinguish data model from displayed aggregate
do not fabricate unexposed per-record attribution

sources.adoptionRule: Only general engineering principles were adapted into repository-owned focused rule packs. Saleor-specific protocol, fields, timeouts, retry constants, tokens, UI and configuration schemas remain non-transferable.
